title: Ventura County Pride Festival
tagline: The Premier LGBTQ+ Cultural Celebration on the Coast
description: Annual coastal festival celebrating community pride, local artists, performers, food, community resource vendors, and intersectional solidarity. Includes a dedicated public health pavilion offering free testing.
admission: Open to all community members; volunteer opportunities available

title: Diversity Gala
tagline: Honoring Champions of Equity and Community Leadership
description: Premier annual benefit gala honoring community advocates, corporate allies, and volunteers whose contributions transform lives across Ventura County.
admission: Ticketed fundraising benefit for DCVC Community Resource Center

title: Pride Prom
tagline: An Unforgettable, Affirming Night for LGBTQ+ Youth
description: Hosted by Rainbow Umbrella for youth ages 13–23. A safe, dry, and welcoming prom where youth can dress authentically, dance with anyone, and celebrate without fear or judgment.
location: DCVC Community Resource Center & Local Venues

title: AIDS Walk Ventura
tagline: Walking in Remembrance, Advocating for a Healthier Future
description: Commemorating loved ones lost to HIV/AIDS, combating healthcare stigmas, and raising dedicated funding for Diversity SHINES rapid screening and PrEP/PEP linkage.
